title: 双指针原地反转
description: 相向双指针原地反转数组
full_code:
def reverse_in_place(arr):
    left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while left < right:
        arr[left], arr[right] = arr[right], arr[left]
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return arr

print(reverse_in_place([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]))
print(reverse_in_place(["a", "b", "c"]))

points.hint: 💡 左右指针分别指向两端
💡 交换后向中间推进，相遇即结束

title: 合并有序数组
description: 双指针归并两个有序数组
full_code:
def merge(a, b):
    i = j = 0
    merged = []
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        if a[i] <= b[j]:
            merged.append(a[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            merged.append(b[j])
            j += 1
    merged.extend(a[i:])
    merged.extend(b[j:])
    return merged

print(merge([1, 3, 5], [2, 4, 6]))

points.hint: 💡 两个指针分别扫描两个数组
💡 每次取较小者放入结果

title: 轮转数组
description: 把数组向右轮转 k 位
full_code:
def rotate(arr, k):
    n = len(arr)
    k = k % n
    return arr[-k:] + arr[:-k]

print(rotate([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2))
print(rotate([1, 2, 3], 7))

points.hint: 💡 k 先对 n 取模
💡 末尾 k 个拼到前面

title: 差分数组
description: 差分标记批量区间加减
full_code:
def diff_update(diff, i, j, val):
    diff[i] += val
    diff[j + 1] -= val

diff = [0] * 6
diff_update(diff, 1, 3, 5)
diff_update(diff, 2, 4, 2)
arr = []
total = 0
for d in diff:
    total += d
    arr.append(total)
print(arr)

💡 对差分做前缀和还原数组

title: 滑动窗口最大和
description: 定长窗口加新减旧 O(1) 滑动
full_code:
def max_window_sum(arr, k):
    window = sum(arr[:k])
    best = window
    for i in range(k, len(arr)):
        window += arr[i] - arr[i - k]
        best = max(best, window)
    return best

print(max_window_sum([2, 1, 5, 1, 3, 2], 3))

points.hint: 💡 先算首个窗口的和
💡 每次滑动加新减旧，避免重复求和

hints.level_3: 👀 接近答案：`window += arr[i] - arr[i - k]`、`best = max(best, window)`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：`window += arr[i] - arr[i - k]`；`best = max(best, window)`

explanation: 固定大小窗口：进一个出一个。把 O(k) 的重算降为 O(1) 的增量更新。
